chr_0002_endminm.name: Endministrator
chr_0002_endminm.profile:
The Endministrator of Endfield Industries.
In the recorded history of Talos-II, the Endministrator stands as a key guardian who protected civilization on this planet and saved humanity from multiple catastrophic disasters. The Endmin's heroic deeds have given rise to many stories, tales, and even rumors.
However, the Endmin's identity remains elusive and only a handful of people have seen the legend in person.
Other factions within the Civilization Band are well aware that Endfield has a very special trump card in their hand, but that is all they know.
The Endministrator's mysterious mastery over Originium and the Protocol Network, along with the Endmin's need for periodic long-term hibernation, is one of Endfield's most important secrets.

chr_0004_pelica.name: Perlica
chr_0004_pelica.quote: I have always believed that you will lead us upon the right path once more. Welcome back to Endfield Industries, Endministrator.
chr_0004_pelica.profile:
"Only by walking upon the land, can we truly appreciate every breath and pulse of life....And this is what Endfield is fighting for.""We once fought on and never gave up...for it is our wish to witness your return."
Perlica is the Supervisor of Endfield Industries, a position she created. In this role, she oversees all company operations and serves as the official spokesperson. She is also a leading expert of Techno-Protocol and the development and application of Protocol-Originium technology, which makes her indispensible to the overall operations of the OMV Dijiang. Her past contributions include spearheading key research that enabled the adaptive use of this technology and assisting in the refinement of the Automated Industry Complex (AIC).

Perlica is characterized by her calm and decisive leadership during crises. While the Endministrator was in hibernation, she assumed command of the Crisis Team, leading its personnel against significant threats. She travels extensively throughout the Civilization Band to maintain order and ensure the operational continuity of Endfield Industries.

chr_0005_chen.name: Chen Qianyu
chr_0005_chen.quote: ENDMIN! HOW ARE —— Oh. Okay, stick with the process. Here goes. Endfield operator Chen Qianyu, reporting for duty!
chr_0005_chen.profile:
"Well, turns out I'm great at something other than martial arts. I just can't help but end up as your best operator."

Chen Qianyu is an operator at Endfield Industries and a core member of the Crisis Team.

From a young age, she trained in martial arts under the guidance of her mother and at Tanjian Hall. Her dedication earned her outstanding combat capabilities and a mental fortitude rarely seen among her peers. Though she has never laid eyes on the legendary Chi Xiao, she proudly upholds her self-developed Chi Xiao Swordmancy, and wields it in the name of justice.

After years of roaming Talos-II alone with her sword, Chen Qianyu joined Endfield at Perlica's invitation. Her upbeat nature and fierce enthusiasm drive her to tackle every urgent challenge without hesitation.

"They say my mother's blade stirred the very clouds themselves, Endmin. And I'll do exactly that ... and become the one that you and Perlica can always count on!"

chr_0006_wolfgd.name: Wulfgard
chr_0006_wolfgd.quote: Catello Wulfgard Luppino, Endfield Crisis Team. I represent the Pack. Give me any merc job, and as long as our contract stands, I'll be your claws and fangs.
chr_0006_wolfgd.profile:
"I know that strength isn't everything, but in Talos-II, you can't live without it."
Catello Wulfgard Luppino is a Landbreaker mercenary living on the fringes of the Civilization Band, now serving on the Crisis Team at Endfield Industries.
Despite his youth, Wulfgard is already well-acquainted with the ficklest nature of humanity. But rather than breaking him, those experiences have given him a maturity far beyond his age. He doesn't seek conflicts, and when in doubt, he prefers to avoid direct confrontation. He is also skilled in stealth and recon combat operations. To complete his mission, the mercenary can even travel with his foes and deal the lethal strike when the enemies least expect it.
A member of the Landbreaker clan known as the Pack, Wulfgard can be a reliable and trustworthy friend if you manage to earn his trust. But that is no easy feat.
"Unrealistic idealism breaks more lives than it saves."

chr_0007_ikut.name: Arclight
chr_0007_ikut.quote: I am Ekut. Callsign is Arclight. I am not a trained weaver of words, but I wish you well and may you flow like a rising river, Endfielders.
chr_0007_ikut.profile:
"I am Ekut. Callsign Arclight. I am not a trained weaver of words, but I wish you well and may you flow like a rising river, Endfielders."
Arclight is a Songseeker who joined Endfield Industries at the recommendation of Aldertone Orisha. She now serves as a field operator and a technical consultant for machinery and vehicles.
No one roaming the wildlands could escape the grip of starvation and disasters, no matter how clever or capable they may think themselves to be. Misfortune struck Arclight hard. The wildlands consumed her entire family, leaving her the only survivor. However, fortune also smiled upon her when a group of Hannabit Circuit Songseekers found and saved her from the brink of death.
The Hannabit Circuit accepted her. There, she quickly learned how to survive in a harsh landscape and follow the example of the Paragons from hannas to help those in need. Today, she roams the wildlands to teach more souls the way of surviving in the unforgiving world of Talos-II.
Arclight may come across as cold and brusque at first, but her minimalist philosophy has proven exceptionally effective for surviving in the wildlands.
"Repairing an iron steed is like treating a cystybeast. One must listen closely before administering the treatment."

Ember serves in the Order of Steel Oath, a military force stationed year-round in the rugged northern regions. To recruit successors for fallen comrades, she returned to the Civilization Band and accepted an invitation to work with Endfield Industries.

To her enemies, she is the bulwark that holds firm. To her allies, she is the wall that never falls. The Order may rest on fortresses and battlecarriers — but warriors like Ember are its true backbone.

chr_0011_seraph.name: Xaihi
chr_0011_seraph.quote: O Knowledge most ancient, lead us not into temptation but deliver us from the codes of malice... I am Xaihi, Endministrator. May you be enlightened.

"Once we are connected, wisdom shall springeth forth."
Xaihi is from the Cabal of Tranquility, a research order dispatched from Laterano to Talos-II for technical study. As a Sessionite, she believes computation and linguistic analysis pave the way to Veritas.
She is better with machines than with people. Her talent in information technology is undeniable — even to the Abbess of the Great Monastery in the Cabal of Tranquility. So despite her "unauthorized" upgrade to the dome of the Cathedralis triggering a cascade of accidents, the Abbess still sincerely recommended her to Endfield Industries, hoping she could find a stage worthy of her genius.
Now, Xaihi works aboard Dijiang on information engineering tasks such as Protorig Network construction and system integration. Her unique insights into the Originium Network, combined with the deep knowledge she carries from the Cabal, ensure her place as an indispensable member of Endfield.

chr_0012_avywen.name: Avywenna
chr_0012_avywen.quote: Well, well, look who it is — the legendary Endministrator. I picked up a couple of whispers on my way here. Curious to know which one's the most accurate? Since you don't know me well yet, here's my offer: how about I tell you a secret in exchange for a little something about you? Whaddya reckon?
chr_0012_avywen.profile:
"Messengers have to safely deliver plenty of secrets, and every one of them comes with a costly price tag. But there is one thing more expensive than the delivery itself, and that is ... my silence on these matters."
Avywenna is an Armed Messenger.
Before joining Endfield Industries, she lived with a powerful logistics family in the Free City of Alloycarrot. Yet the wanderlust in her blood drove her to leave that life and begin her own journey. Across the many destinations of Talos-II, she discovered a thread that bound them together — the mysterious Endministrator.
Avywenna shines in social settings, handling all kinds of relationships with maturity and professionalism. As to whether she's truly as good-tempered as she seems, you'll have to find out by engaging with her yourself.
"Nobody likes insolence ... so if we can talk things out, I'd much rather do that than get physical. But just so we're clear, I don't tolerate insolence well either."

Her duties often require her to travel along the boundaries between the Civilization Band and the frontier, but she seems to really enjoy the job. Because of the significant talent gap, Snowshine and her rescue team are always faced with a busy schedule, even on days with no special missions.

He continues to grow with sincerity and passion, yearning for the day he can take on greater responsibilities. chr_0016_laevat.profile:
"Let that twilight burn!"
Laevatain is a Rhodes Island operator who joined Endfield at the Endministrator's direct recommendation. Under the framework agreement between the two companies, she serves as an operator directly under the Endministrator's command.
Before joining Endfield Industries, Laevatain roamed the world alone, pursuing a goal she could call her own. Because of that journey, and her formidable skill in solo combat, people often mistake her for "someone you can't talk to." In truth, the opposite is closer to reality. It's only that her earnest, forthright nature sometimes comes across too strongly, giving rise to misunderstanding.
At times, though, she speaks in ways that confound others, often circling back to the subject of "memory," as if she were purposefully trying to separate herself from who she is.
She often wields flames, yet craves ice cream just as much. To her, maybe that contradiction feels perfectly natural.
"Try getting closer to me if you're still feeling cold."

chr_0017_yvonne.name: Yvonne
chr_0017_yvonne.quote: Hi, Endmin. We meet again. Just call me Yvonne. It's been a very long time since I last went out. Pleasure doing business together!
chr_0017_yvonne.profile:
"This pair of handcannons feels just right. Hmm... Noticed a few design OFIs. Guess I'll just mod them into a pair of Yvonne-specials!"
Yvonne is an operator in the Specialist Tech Division of Endfield Industries, currently responsible for research on Æther, Blight and related devices.
At first glance, Yvonne looks like your typical rebellious fashionista — painting her horns, tail, and nails in eye-popping colors. She'll skip out on academic conferences just to snag the latest fashion magazines and pop albums. Drawn to all things new and unconventional, Yvonne has a knack for staying one step ahead of the trends, always marching to the beat of her own drum.
But no one can deny that she is a true genius. Even back in her school days, she was racking up accolades in scientific research that others could only dream of. Everyone expected her to join a top-tier research institute and lead the charge in her field. Instead, Yvonne turned her back on it all and chose to join Endfield.
The reason? She never explained it. Maybe you can ask her yourself.
"Can I apply new layer of coating for my gear? This color scheme doesn't really match my hair."

chr_0018_dapan.name: Da Pan
chr_0018_dapan.quote: Oh, we meet again, Endmin. Got an engineering problem? Point it out, and consider it fixed! And I'll be EVEN happier if there's canteen work for me!
chr_0018_dapan.profile:
"If you're not good with a dish, just make it more often! I don't cook to show off! I do it to make a pretty and joyful feast!"
Da Pan hails from the prestigious Hongshan Academy of Sciences, but after leaving, he took up all kinds of "dispersed key logistical support roles" — from chef and electrician to chauffeur and street vendor. His latest move? Joining the Specialist Tech Division of Endfield Industries as an independent.
Of all the roles he's taken on, the one he's most proud of is being a traveling chef. He's passionate about exploring new recipes and creating inventive dishes. Nothing makes him happier than crafting delicious meals that win praise from every diner he serves.
There's a water bottle Da Pan keeps with him at all times, though few ever notice it. Those who can read Yanese characters might wonder about its origin. But if they're from Hongshan, they'll know exactly where it came from and the weight it carries as an honor awarded only to a Vanguard Scientist.
"Try this. I cooked it myself!"

chr_0019_karin.name: Akekuri
chr_0019_karin.quote: Captain Akekuri of Operation Team Z7 reporting in! The operations dossier, budget summary, and action plan are ready for review. Which would you like to read first?
chr_0019_karin.profile:
"Akekuri, Op Z7, reporting in! Excited to join the mission, let's make it a success!"
Akekuri, Captain of Operations Team Z7 under the Specialist Tech Division, is known for her smile and that trademark line: "Leave it to me." From mission planning to day-to-day management, she handles it all. Beyond tactical command and strategy, she's a master of coordination who always uncovers the optimal solution, even with limited resources. She also knows how to care for her team, making sure everyone works in harmony and shines in the role that suits them best.
She practically built Operations Team Z7 from the ground up. In just a few short months, she handled everything from recruitment and training to full deployment, leading the team to remarkable results. And to think, not long ago, she was just an honors student from the Business School who volunteered to join Endfield. No one expected a newcomer to rise so quickly and become a captain truly worthy of trust.
If you've ever wondered about her passion, her drive, and her idealism, or about the simple wish that keeps her going, then...
"Coffee break, Endmin? I can whip up a fresh pot for you!"

Physically weak, and shadowed by misfortune wherever she goes, she sometimes lets her sharp tongue and dark humor push outsiders away. Her dream is simple: to live a peaceful life. A life of danger and extremes has numbed her senses to the world and raised her threshold for stimulation. As a result, she sometimes seeks out harsher forms of challenge — like the pounding rush of heavy metal music. Those rare jolts give her a fleeting sense of change and something real.

 He isn't keen on talking about his "boring" past. All that's known is that he clawed his way through the frontier's underclass, enduring strife and betrayal at every turn. In the end, he left the streets behind with one blind eye and a body worn by exhaustion.

"Livin' the happy life is important. True legit wisdom from an old boy, Endmin."

Ardelia's early work centered on volcanoes, but today her research extends into Ætherside and geological disasters. chr_0026_lastrite.name: Last Rite
chr_0026_lastrite.quote: Seš'qa liaison, reporting in for duty... My name... I-I mean my codename's Last Rite... Just call me that...
chr_0026_lastrite.profile:
"I am the ... something of war, I guess?"
Before the Sarkaz of the floating city found her, Last Rite was a kind-hearted girl adopted by a Caprinae gravekeeper couple. Shaped by their teachings, the young Nachzehrer refused to disturb the dead, resisting her instinct to feed. But that restraint left her reeling with hunger, and her insecurity made her shrink away from others.
A chance encounter revealed Last Rite's potential to Seš'qa. Enticed by the promise of "well-paid temp work" and "training to suppress instincts," she came to be known among merchants as the Princess of the War Court. Now, clad in a Witching Hour prototype combat suit, she wields frost and steel for Endfield's cause — both to fulfill her contract and to strive toward the peaceful future that Endfield has set before her.
"If my contract with Seš'qa expires, you can contact me... O-oh no! I wasn't supposed to say that! Please... Don't tell anyone about this..."

chr_0027_tangtang.name: Tangtang
chr_0027_tangtang.quote: Qingbo Stockade's Chief, Tangtang, reporting as promised! Now you can just hand Endfield over to me; I'll make it the toughest spot on Talos-II! Turn in a proposal? C'mon, since when does a chief do paperwork? We'll just figure it out together!
chr_0027_tangtang.profile:
"Your Supreme Chief is here! You, you, and you, are all under my command!"

Tangtang, the Supreme Chief of Qingbo Stockade. She is straightforward, values loyalty, and acts with a free-spirited and unconstrained nature. She loves freedom and playing in the water, but hates betrayal. Once she recognizes you as her friend, she will go to any lengths to support you.

As an infant, Tangtang was placed in a bamboo basket by someone unknown and drifted down the river to Qingbo Stockade, where she was adopted by the Stockaders and became one of their own. In the eyes of many, she is still a child in need of pampering, but in her heart, she has long since resolved to shoulder the future of Qingbo Stockade.

Despite having experienced many setbacks, she remains full of passion for the world. In order to find answers to her questions and to better develop Qingbo Stockade, Tangtang has joined Endfield Industries.

"Keep her away from Mi Fu, or things might get broken" — so says an operator from the Chief Logistics Office.

"You called me over just to praise me? Well, lay it on thicker then. I love hearing the truth!"

chr_0028_wulfa.name: Rossi
chr_0028_wulfa.quote: I'm Rossina, granted name Wulfperl, meaning the Pack's treasure! You'd better remember that! Ah ... Endmin, you can call me whatever you prefer...
chr_0028_wulfa.profile:
"Piece of cake for an elite like me!"

Rossina Wulfperl Luppino, younger sister of Wulfgard and the Pearl of the Pack. In a feud between the Pack and the Bonekrushers, many elder wolves paid a bloody price to rescue her. The blood that day stained her swaddling blanket red...

Wulfgard operates independently from the clan for years, but the Pack required a leader, and Rossi accepted that responsibility. She has always felt that her brother, who rose to fame at a young age, should be the one leading the entire Pack, and she constantly reminds and urges him to do so. While the elders of the clan hope Rossi can spend more time doing what she loves at her age, she ultimately cannot lift the weight of "responsibility" from her heart. She strives to become more reliable and powerful for the sake of her family and her clan.

Rossi, who longs for heroic tales, occasionally fantasizes that one day she will be able to fight alongside a legendary hero. This is the bit of "me time" she reserves for herself.

"They bit deep, but the Pack isn't afraid of more scars!"

chr_0029_pograni.profile:
"The situation is urgent. I respectfully request a brief on your battle plan, at your earliest convenience."
Pogranichnik is a Rhodes Island operator assigned to Endfield Industries where he serves as a military consultant under the framework agreement between the two companies.
 With deep knowledge of military theory and hard-won experience in team combat, Pogranichnik leads his unit through even the most unexpected crises. Once commander of the Shieldguard Banner in the Order of Steel Oath, he and his troops came to be regarded as among the most reliable on the front lines against the Aggeloi. But as the situation on Talos-II grew increasingly complex, he joined Endfield Industries without hesitation. He firmly believes that the Endministrator will lead Talos-II onto a new path, just as he once envisioned.
"Endmin, I have no doubt that your actions will put a solemn end to this cruel cycle of war and sacrifice."

chr_0030_zhuangfy.name: Zhuang Fangyi
chr_0030_zhuangfy.quote: Endmin, before I officially come on board, I'd like to say a few words. As Viceroy, I am experienced in administrative duties. However ... here in Endfield, I wish to serve as a regular Tianshi and focus on research.
chr_0030_zhuangfy.profile:
"If you never give up, you never really lose."

Operator Zhuang Fangyi, serves as the Viceroy of the Wuling Scientific Developmental District, and also the Tianshi in charge of the Novel Xiranite-based Materials Project. Upon recommendation from the HAS, she joined Endfield Industries to conduct rift-related research.

Zhuang Fangyi, a native of Hongshan, demonstrated extraordinary aptitude from an early age and was admitted to the Tianshi Bureau Academies before reaching adulthood with outstanding academic performance. She was later selected for the Xiranite Project due to her exceptional abilities, becoming the youngest member of the Wuling Science Station. Following a disaster that resulted in near-total loss of personnel at the Science Station, she, despite being the most junior member, was appointed to the position of Viceroy, assuming leadership responsibilities and bearing the weight of all Wuling.

Appointed in a time of crisis, she quickly pulled herself together. In just a single decade, she not only built Wuling into a thriving city but also, through trial and error, grew into a dedicated and responsible leader. However, the disaster from a decade ago remains a sword hanging over everyone's heads, constantly reminding her that the peace and prosperity of Wuling City could vanish in an instant.

"So long as we still stand, nothing is truly lost."

chr_0031_mifu.name: Mi Fu
chr_0031_mifu.quote: Enough talk. This time, I'll clean up the mess for you. But I do things directly. If something breaks, Endfield foots the bills.
chr_0031_mifu.profile:
"We're battle-forged teammates, right?"

Mi Fu, Captain of the Wuling Watch and trusted subordinate of Viceroy Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi. A perennial winner of Wuling's "Vanguard Stars" award, she ranks second on the city's civilian combat power leaderboard. To her colleagues, she is both the strictest instructor and the most caring superior. A regular at the sweet rice cake stall on Fangxing Avenue, she is a hero to children, a nightmare for troublemakers, and the bane of any invader. Though labeled a "traitor" by Qingbo Stockade, she remains the true successor of Qingbo Martial Arts. Tangtang's childhood friend and rival, she is a warrior who fought to the bitter end against the Blight Tide without ever retreating...

If you want to know Mi Fu better, you can either become her rival or her friend those are the two relationships she values most. The former gets her blood pumping; the latter drives her to throw every punch without regard for her own life.

Now, to repay the friends who fought by her side and to take on more rivals worth fighting again and again, she has begun her exchange journey at Endfield Industries.

"This time, I'll clean up the mess for you."

chr_0032_lizhiyan.quote: YSTF Task Leader, Arcane, reporting to Endfield... Awaiting your orders, Commander.
chr_0032_lizhiyan.profile:
"I will uphold the honor of the Yinglungs."

Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) captain, Arcane, long stationed at Yinglung Pass, frequently undertakes survey missions within the exclusion zone. She is serious, meticulous, and never one to smile readily.

The disaster in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone took everything from Arcane. Since then, her only purpose in life has been to contain the Wuling Very Large Rift. She has ventured deep into it time and again.

Hatred leads her step by step into the Deep, yet it also keeps her alive when all hope seems lost. You can find all the qualities of a YSTF member in Arcane: absolute obedience to orders, outstanding tactical command, relentless training day and night, and an unyielding spirit. Those who have likewise lost loved ones to disasters can see a part of themselves in Arcane...

Some find her frigid, but for YSTF members, maintaining distance is also a form of mutual protection.

"Be of ferrium will, move as a razor's edge. Yinglung wins by momentum."

chr_0033_camille.name: Camille
chr_0033_camille.quote: Camille Arno, Agaš'mekanaz of Seš'qa. I seek a dangerous Sarkaz criminal who wields witchcraft as a weapon. For this, I require the strength of Endfield... And in return, I vow to offer you my own.
chr_0033_camille.profile:
"Out of the deepest shadows, a drop of blood is drawn once more."

Camille Arno, a Keeper from Seš'qa specializing in handling violent incidents caused by or targeted at the Sarkaz. As one of the most elite Keepers, he has mastered blood-related Originium Arts and is especially skilled at countering all manner of sinister witchcraft.

To protect his homeland, Seš'qa, Camille has personally apprehended countless dangerous criminals, yet he has faced repeated setbacks in his hunt for his blood relative. Scarred by past betrayals, he has grown used to maintaining a cold, distant demeanor and avoiding others' concern - this is how he protects himself. Yet when it comes to friends who have earned his trust, he is willing to reveal a sincere and straightforward side.

Currently, he is seeking to cooperate with Endfield Industries in a personal capacity. He looks forward to journeying alongside you to distant lands and fulfilling each other's long-cherished wishes.

"Empty honors no longer matter, my friend. My blood is always with you."

chr_0034_typhoea.name: Typhoeus
chr_0034_typhoea.quote: Endmin, I sought you out and fulfilled my promise. What about yours? Have you found a good story to share with me?
chr_0034_typhoea.profile:
"A good story is like a good hunter. Both aim straight for the heart."

Typhoeus, huntress of the wilds from Rhodes Island, is curious about the world. She is eager to delve into uninhabited and unexplored places to
uncover the forgotten past.

On Talos-II, many legends of Sami have already faded, and only a handful of Samifjod still remember them. Typhoeus has resolved to visit them one by one, recording those shattered memories in her notebook.

After arriving at Endfield, the stories she pursued were no longer confined to forgotten legends. She met many new friends and exchanged
stories with people from across the land. And in pursuing those legends, she is also writing a story of her own.

One day, when every page of her notebook has been filled, she will proclaim to the friends around her: "Legends aren't always too far off... They can happen right next to us."

At present, Liino is methodically pushing ahead with plans for her Talos-II concert tour. She believes she will deliver a performance unlike anything seen before, and that the day will come when she'll shine bright at the top of the world.

chr_0036_jsspsi.name: Si
chr_0036_jsspsi.quote: Hold it, keep it still! The ink isn't even dry yet... This painting's for you. What I drew isn't important. It's my seal that matters! And don't you ever forget my name again!
chr_0036_jsspsi.profile:
"Hmph. Only think of me when trouble shows up?"

Si is one of the few Feranmut Proxies on Talos-II. The Feranmuts are paracausal beings native to Terra, and the consciousness that They manifest in slumber before human presence is known as Feranmut Proxy.

Si's relationship with her Feranmut is somewhat complicated, but people still habitually refer to her as a Feranmut Proxy. In truth, Si is no
one's Proxy. She is simply herself. Beneath her formidable and mysterious exterior lies a young soul who still holds onto hope and curiosity about the world.

In her daily life, she uses her abilities to provide comprehensive support for HAS and Endfield. In her spare time, she enjoys exploring the cities of Talos-II in search of the latest technologies and fashion trends. She follows her heart's desires and is unfettered by conventions.

"I'll help you out again. Remember to pay up once we get back to the inn."

chr_0038_purrche.name: Purrchena
chr_0038_purrche.quote: Greetings, Endmin! I am the Brand Ambassador for the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation — Purrchena! My dream is to be ... someone just like y... "Brand Ambassador for the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation — Purrchena!"... *gasp* no, no, no, I dozed off again!
chr_0038_purrche.profile:
"My turn to ... 'Meow-dy!' ...Ugh, how am I asleep again?!"

Purrchena is a big fan of desserts and serves as the spokesperson for the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation. She joined the Business Office of Endfield Industries at the recommendation of the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce (TGCC) and has since become the liaison between Endfield and TGCC in the field of Ætherside Syndrome.

When Purrchena first stepped into the public eye, the love and care people showed her made her aware of the responsibility she carried. But after she became the Foundation's spokesperson and stood alongside those living with Ætherside Syndrome, she realized how little she could do.

Even though Ætherside Syndrome often caused her to fall asleep without warning, every time she woke up, she would set out again, carrying
everyone's love with her. In her own way, Purrchena keeps the other patients receiving help smiling.

"Got my marshmallows and exotic dried fin... Alright, I'm good to go!"
